text.tspan: Electoral democracy as defined by the Lexical Index of Electoral Democracy: an elected government and
parliament, universal voting rights, and competitive elections.
Note: Democracies here include those regimes classified by Skaaning et al. as electoral democracies and polyarchies (full democracies).
